data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting result in 2019 was affected by catastrophe events mainly Hurricane Dorian, Typhoon Faxai and Typhoon Hagibis, as well as deterioration on prior year catastrophe events mainly Hurricane Irma. Collectively, these represented net losses of GBP 16,700k. There has also been significant prior year deterioration on Woodstock and Personal Accident that were discontinued in 2018 and Financial Lines, General Casualty and Hull.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims reserves at the start of 2019 were GBP 337.016m. The syndicate's gross prior-year reserve movements, measured from the gross claims development table, show no material aggregate gross prior-year development (calculated as effectively nil). However the Managing Agent reports net adverse development driven by catastrophe activity and prior year deterioration - specifically Hurricane Dorian, Typhoon Faxai, Typhoon Hagibis and deterioration relating to prior-year Hurricane Irma and discontinued portfolios (Woodstock and Personal Accident). These pressures impacted Property, Casualty and Accident & Health related lines, but a quantifiable gross PYD amount is not given in the movement notes; the gross triangle indicates flat development for older underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided in a 'movement in prior year's provision' note. The gross claims development triangle was used as the authoritative source and indicates no material gross prior-year development for underwriting years <=2017 (aggregate  0). The report does however state net adverse development (net of reinsurance) of GBP 16.7m for catastrophe events; that net figure was not convertible to a gross amount from available notes. Prior-year deterioration is described qualitatively for specific portfolios (Woodstock, Personal Accident, Financial Lines, General Casualty, Hull) but not quantified on a gross basis.
